## Overview
- **Name**: React Dashboard
- **Description**: React 19 / Vite SPA providing the full operator interface for vQA — ticket selection, test launch, live execution monitoring, human-in-the-loop intervention, failure triage, analytics, and historical report browsing
- **Type**: UI Module (Single-Page Application)
- **Technology**: TypeScript / React 19 / Vite 8

## Purpose
The React Dashboard is the primary interface through which QA engineers and operators interact with the vQA system. It orchestrates the full test lifecycle: selecting a Jira ticket and role, optionally reviewing and editing parsed AC steps, launching an execution, watching step-by-step progress via WebSocket streaming (live screenshots, agent reasoning, action log), intervening manually when the agent is stuck (Normal HITL or Click-to-Teach modes), triaging failures with LLM-generated analysis, and browsing or re-running historical reports. The dashboard is a separate deployable unit — a static Vite bundle served by a web server or co-deployed in the same Docker container as the backend — and communicates exclusively with the vQA Backend through REST calls and a WebSocket stream.

## Software Features

1. **Test Execution Control Panel** — Operators select a Jira ticket from a live dropdown (with search, status/priority indicators, and credential pre-checks), choose a user role, set target URL and execution mode (interactive/headless), review and inline-edit parsed AC steps, and inject guidance at two moments (pre-parse and pre-execute) before launching a test run.

2. **Real-Time Execution Monitoring** — ExecutionLog displays a scrolling, auto-updating feed of agent actions with LLM reasoning per step. LiveBrowser renders streamed base64 screenshots from the backend, giving operators a live view of the browser. ThinkingCard animates agent reasoning text between steps. A cancel button halts in-flight runs.

3. **Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Intervention** — When the agent is stuck, TakeoverPanel replaces LiveBrowser and offers two intervention modes: Normal HITL (click-to-inject mouse/keyboard/scroll actions directly into the running browser) and Click-to-Teach (auto-capture element selectors and human-authored "why" descriptions, then save them to the Knowledge Base via the `/teach` endpoint).

4. **Failure Triage and Re-Run Guidance** — TriagePanel surfaces after a failed run, displaying LLM-generated per-step classifications (Product Bug / Jira Unclear / Mixed) with confidence scores, an executive summary, and options to re-run with guidance, post the analysis to Jira, or dismiss. Re-run guidance is pre-filled into ExecutionPanel for the next cycle.

5. **AC Step Progress Tracker (CopilotSidebar)** — Displays each acceptance-criteria step's status (pending, in_progress, passed, failed, skipped, awaiting_human) with a progress bar and per-step error messages. Provides Resume and Skip controls during human takeover. Shows a pass/fail completion banner on terminal state.

6. **Persona Credential Prompt (PersonaCredentialPanel)** — A HITL overlay shown when the agent needs credentials for an unknown persona. The operator provides email/password inline; the dashboard posts them back to the backend via WebSocket message to resume the run without restarting.

7. **Reports Archive and Historical Browsing** — ReportsArchive tab displays all past runs from S3 in either a grouped-by-ticket view (with collapsible ticket cards and role indicators) or a chronological timeline. ReportsHistory panel on the Run tab shows recent reports with search, role filtering, and quick-action links (Open Report, Watch Video, Re-run).

8. **Analytics Dashboard** — AnalyticsDashboard tab shows aggregated metrics over selectable time windows (7/14/30/90 days): pass rate ring chart, total runs, average cost, average duration, AC step statistics, most-tested tickets table, and a recent runs list.

## Outbound Interfaces

### REST API (to vQA Backend)

All calls use `API_BASE_URL`, read from the `VITE_API_URL` environment variable (default: `http://localhost:8000`).

| Method | Path | Consumer Component | Purpose |
|--------|------|--------------------|---------|
| GET | `/health` | useExecution | Backend + integration health check (Jira, S3, Bedrock) |
| GET | `/tickets` | ExecutionPanel | Fetch Jira board tickets for selector dropdown |
| GET | `/ticket/{ticketId}/credentials` | useExecution | Check credential completeness for selected ticket |
| GET | `/preview-steps?ticket_id=...&pre_parse_guidance=...` | ExecutionPanel | Parse AC steps with optional pre-parse guidance |
| POST | `/execute` | useExecution | Start a new test run; returns `run_id` and WebSocket URL |
| GET | `/status/{runId}` | useExecution | Poll run progress (status, step counters, artifact URLs) |
| POST | `/run/{runId}/cancel` | ExecutionLog | Halt an in-progress run |
| POST | `/run/{runId}/interact` | TakeoverPanel | Inject mouse click / keystroke / scroll in Normal HITL mode |
| POST | `/run/{runId}/teach/capture-click` | TakeoverPanel | Click-to-Teach: auto-detect element selector from click coords |
| POST | `/run/{runId}/teach` | TakeoverPanel | Execute click and persist selector + guidance to Knowledge Base |
| POST | `/runs/{runId}/human-takeover/done` | TakeoverPanel / CopilotSidebar | Resume execution after human intervention |
| POST | `/runs/{runId}/human-takeover/skip` | CopilotSidebar | Skip the stuck AC step |
| POST | `/run/{runId}/post-to-jira` | TriagePanel | Post triage analysis as Jira comment |
| GET | `/runs/analytics?days={days}` | AnalyticsDashboard | Fetch aggregated metrics for selected time window |
| GET | `/runs/history?limit=20` | AnalyticsDashboard | Fetch recent run list |
| GET | `/reports` | ReportsHistory / ReportsArchive | Fetch historical audit run records from S3 |

### WebSocket (to vQA Backend)

Connection URL uses `WS_BASE_URL`, read from the `VITE_WS_URL` environment variable (default: `ws://localhost:8000`).

| Connection | Path | Hook | Purpose |
|------------|------|------|---------|
| WS | `/ws/{runId}` | useWebSocket | Real-time stream of execution events for a single run |

**Inbound WebSocket message types handled:**

| Message Type | Handler State | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `step` | `steps[]` | Append agent action (click/type/scroll) with reasoning and success flag |
| `thinking` | `isThinking`, `thinkingText` | Display animated LLM reasoning between steps |
| `screenshot` | `latestScreenshot` | Update LiveBrowser with latest base64 PNG from agent |
| `ac_progress` | CopilotSidebar | Update per-step status icons and progress bar |
| `copilot_ready` | `humanTakeoverMessage` | Signal agent is stuck; switch to TakeoverPanel |
| `triage` | `triageMessage` | Show TriagePanel with per-step failure classification |
| `completed` / `failed` | `terminalMessage` | Display terminal summary; close WebSocket |

## Environment Configuration

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `VITE_API_URL` | `http://localhost:8000` | Backend REST base URL (injected at build time by Vite) |
| `VITE_WS_URL` | `ws://localhost:8000` | Backend WebSocket base URL (injected at build time by Vite) |


## Custom Hooks (Data Layer)

| Hook | Responsibility |
|------|----------------|
| `useExecution()` | REST API calls — start run, poll status, health check, credential check |
| `useWebSocket()` | WebSocket lifecycle — connect, stream messages, disconnect, reset state |

These hooks are independent but composed together in Dashboard: `useExecution` provides the `run_id` that `useWebSocket.connect()` requires.

## Deployment

- **Build artifact**: Static bundle produced by `npm run build` (`tsc -b && vite build`) into `dist/`
- **Runtime**: No server-side rendering; served as static files by nginx, a CDN, or co-located with the backend Docker container
- **Dev server**: `npm run dev` — Vite HMR on port 5173
- **No server-side secrets**: All configuration is injected via `VITE_*` environment variables at build time; no sensitive values should appear in the bundle

## Key Design Decisions

- **Dual HITL modes**: TakeoverPanel offers Normal (inject actions) and Click-to-Teach (build KB) in a single panel with a mode toggle, keeping the intervention surface minimal.
- **Two-moment guidance system**: Guidance can be injected at AC-parse time (pre-parse, affects step generation) and at execution time (pre-execute, sent with run request); TriagePanel re-run guidance flows back as pending guidance consumed by ExecutionPanel on the next cycle.
- **No external charting library**: AnalyticsDashboard uses a pure SVG circular progress ring, keeping the bundle lean.
- **WebSocket reset on new ticket**: `useWebSocket.resetState()` clears all run state without closing the socket, preventing stale data from previous runs bleeding into the new selection.
- **TakeoverPanel takes precedence over CopilotSidebar**: When `activeTakeover` is set, TakeoverPanel replaces CopilotSidebar in the main panel, ensuring the operator sees the intervention surface immediately.
- **PersonaCredentialPanel as overlay**: Unknown-persona HITL is rendered as an overlay (`.dashboard-persona-creds`) rather than replacing any existing panel, so the execution log remains visible for context.
- **Future architecture intent**: The Run tab may be extracted into a dedicated `RunTestView` component implementing a strict SELECT → REVIEW → RUNNING → COMPLETE state machine, decoupling configuration from execution (see `systemPatterns.md` — Mode-Centric Progressive Disclosure). This has not yet been implemented.
